Monica / team —

We can take the Aug 28 02:30–04:30 PDT canary. Quick confirmations and runbook notes below (summarized):

Canary/rollback thresholds (we will implement automated gating):
- Error rate: > 2% sustained for 3 minutes -> automatic rollback to previous routing model.
- Latency: p95 > 400ms sustained for 5 minutes -> alert and manual review (we prefer manual rollback on latency unless accompanied by errors).
- Provisioning anomalies: SCIM bulk failures (more than 10% per batch) -> pause provisioning and alert.

Day‑Zero sequence (engineer checklist):
1) Validate SAML metadata (IdP cert fingerprint vs provided XML) and smoke an SP test account.
2) Confirm IP allowlist acceptance from NovaHealth: we will route traffic only from approved CIDRs.
3) Deploy canary routing to 5% of production tokens; monitor traces for 15min.
4) Enable prefix/KV caching for read ops; keep write path direct.
5) Run SCIM mapping validation against 50 pilot users; verify roles->groups mapping.
6) If green at 30m, ramp to 25%, then 100% over next 2 hours.
7) Post‑cutover audit: export provisioning logs, token usage, and latency summary (Retain for 30 days).

Service account notes:
- We will accept a scoped service account. Please provide a user email and an OAuth client id for SCIM. Token rotation: we’ll require a new token before ramp to 25%.

I attached the cutover runbook draft (privilege-cutover-runbook.md) with exact CLI commands and smoke tests. I’ll be available during the window; Jordan will handle tracing hooks and logs.

Ben Carter
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
